name: wistia
label: Wistia
description: Video hosting and analytics for business. Manage your projects and media library.

token.label: API Access Token
token.description:
To get your Wistia API access token:
1. Log in to your Wistia account.
2. Go to **Account Settings > API Access** (or visit https://my.wistia.com/account/api).
3. Click **Create Token** and give it a name.
4. Grant it the permissions you need (read/update/delete) and copy the token — it is only shown once.
5. Paste the token below.

find_media.label: Find Media
find_media.description: Search and list media in your account, optionally filtered by project, name, or type.

projectId.label: Project
projectId.description: Only return media that belong to this project.

name.label: Name
name.description: Only return media whose name exactly matches this value.

type.label: Type
type.description: Only return media of this type.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of media to return (up to 100).
